principles: a technically green candidate is not automatically an executed closing condition
current-main survivors supersede historical green branches for final acquired-state evidence
PROVEN is scoped to the named control and never implies full G1 closure
READY_TO_EXECUTE is a bounded package and never authorizes production or legal execution
EXTERNAL_REQUIRED needs qualified counsel tax trademark review or an independent human operator
BLOCKED means an upstream dependency prevents truthful closure
Contact Freeze remains until G1 closes and internal review explicitly releases it

g1DoneRule: G1 may be declared ACQUISITION_CLEAN only when every P0 control is PROVEN or covered by a documented buyer-acceptable carve-out approved by the relevant authority, acquired-state evidence has been regenerated, and Contact Freeze has not been released prematurely.
